segmenter.short_fragment_policy: merge with previous; prefix merges with next

pooling: Unit-normalize each mean/max pooled local vector; concatenate unit whole and local vectors divided by sqrt(2). Whole duplicate uses the same construction. Zero pooled norm falls back to whole.
selection_rule: Only mean/max candidates with strictly higher exact-set accuracy and no lower three-intent exact accuracy than whole are eligible; rank by exact_set_accuracy, micro_f1, micro_precision, earlier representation. Otherwise retain whole.
boundaries: Designed after observing earlier development studies; frozen before these representation fits.
Heuristic text spans are unvalidated segmentation, not gold requests, action evidence, or semantic parsing.
No hyperparameter/threshold search, encoder updates, calibration/test access or browser promotion.
Four representations share training labels and fixed classifier settings; selection remains development-only.
